newsitem.title: NIGER: France gives Niger $21 million adjustment aid.
newsitem.headline: France gives Niger $21 million adjustment aid.

text.p: France is to give Niger 12 billion CFA francs ($21 million) to help its economic development within the framework of an IMF structural adjustment programme, Niger's Prime Minister Ahmadou Cisse said on Tuesday.
France gave nine billion CFA francs during the first year of the programme to April 1997.

Cisse, who has just returned to Niamey after an official one-week visit to France, said the IMF board would be deciding whether to release loans for the second year of the Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility at the end of July.
The facility is worth 45 billion CFA francs, to be released in three equal annual tranches.
